name: phd-project-course-total-only
description: Credit-transfer review 2026-10-28 (#37): on the Ph.D. a course the Courses tab types “project” read “counts toward the project/thesis requirement” — a requirement the Ph.D. does not have — while counting toward the 60 only. It now reads “counts toward the total-credit requirement only”. (On the MSCSE only CSE 68901/68902 fill §3.2’s six project credits, by number.)

CSE 68902: counts toward the total-credit requirement only (3 cr)
